reason: The sponsor-loaded tablet is central to the private request desk, but its needed changes aren't yet clear.
expectation: Inspection should reveal what can be used to remove or bypass the sponsor's listening app.

alternatives.reason: The screwdriver might open the tablet, but the problem appears to involve software.

effect: The sponsor app is removed and the microphone disconnected, giving the request desk a private foundation.
reaction: The physical disconnect makes the privacy change satisfyingly concrete.
reason: A large request button appears to be a useful input for the tablet's request form.
expectation: The button should be fitted to the tablet for making requests.

effect: The tablet now has an accessible physical Send button, while its microphone remains disconnected.
reaction: The button's connection to the form is a clear, practical improvement.
reason: The screen hood should help keep requests private from nearby observers.
expectation: The hood will fit around the tablet screen to limit viewing from the sides.

effect: The tablet now shields the form from the queue while retaining the large Send button.
reaction: The distinction between physical access and visual privacy is useful.
reason: The portable controller can likely connect the private tablet to the local request network.
expectation: The tablet will join the local network without relying on the corporate uplink.

alternatives.reason: The printer may provide a paper record, but connecting the desk locally seems more fundamental.

effect: The tablet now sends requests through the local controller with its outside route blocked.
reaction: The local-only connection makes the privacy setup more concrete.
reason: Moth may provide the optional AI help called for by the goal without changing the tablet's private input setup.

choice.combine: Moth with source display and correction controls

expectation: Moth will be connected as an optional source of assistance for the request desk.

alternatives.reason: The printer may also be needed for the desk, but the goal explicitly calls for optional AI help.

effect: Moth currently has no available combination, so the desk may need another component before AI assistance can be added.
reaction: I was surprised the apparent AI connection was not available yet.
reason: The old receipt printer is the remaining desk component and may connect to the prepared tablet.
expectation: The printer will provide a paper record for requests, possibly preparing the desk for optional AI help.

effect: The printer and tablet now form a desk, but the printer still needs to be assigned to the local controller.
reaction: The remaining setup step is clear.
reason: The printer needs assignment to the controller, so connecting the desk to it is the direct next step.
expectation: The controller will be configured to use the desk's printer.

effect: The desk now has local printing, private return details and a pencil alternative; optional AI assistance remains to be addressed.
reaction: The paper option is a useful alternative to using the tablet.
reason: The completed desk may now be ready to connect to Moth for optional assistance.

choice.with: Moth with source display and correction controls

expectation: Moth will be made available as optional help without requiring people to use it.

effect: Moth is now available only when the sender selects Help, and its proposed wording can be reviewed before sending. The desk goal is complete.
reaction: Sal keeping her original wording makes the optional help feel genuinely optional.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting Moth to the completed desk was most worthwhile: the sender chooses whether to use it and reviews its suggestion before sending.

leastWorthwhile.text: The premature attempt to connect Moth was unproductive; it returned only that Moth could not be combined with anything.

surprise.text: I expected Moth to connect to the prepared tablet, but the printer and desk setup had to come first.

arbitrary.text: The need to finish printer setup before adding Moth felt somewhat arbitrary; the result did not explain why the AI connection depended on it.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the concrete privacy choices and the sender's control over AI assistance made me curious about how the neighborhood uses its local infrastructure.
